p: Because Out of Bounds is a local independent venue rather than part of a big national chain, the best thing you can do is check the details directly before you travel. Look up current session times, what activities are running and any age or height guidance for the different areas. That way you'll know exactly who in the family can do what, and nobody ends up disappointed at the door.

When it comes to clothing, think sporty and practical. Trainers, leggings or joggers and a T-shirt are perfect, with long hair tied back and pockets emptied. A water bottle is a must, as climbing and active play get you warm fast, and a snack for afterwards will keep tempers sweet on the drive home. If there's any paperwork to complete before climbing, doing it in advance saves time.
Angmering is easy to reach. The village has its own railway station on the West Coastway line between Brighton and Portsmouth, and the A27 and A259 run close by for drivers.

Fancy more nearby? Highdown Gardens, on the edge of Worthing, is a free chalk garden with lovely views, created on an old chalk pit. Rustington, next door, has a beach and a good parade of shops. Littlehampton's riverside and beach are a short drive west, and Arundel Wetland Centre, near Arundel, is a brilliant place to spot birds and wildlife from boardwalks and boat safaris.
